text:
Maya (Marketing): Heads-up — we're planning to launch the Community Snippets Starter Pack next Tue (May 12). Goal: low-friction dev onramp + SEO + lead capture.

Liam (DevRel): love this. Specs?

Maya (Marketing): 10 curated snippets (python/js/bash), each with 1-line copy, example, quick benchmark (latency + cost). We want a short blog post, 3 social posts, a 45-min webinar demo.

Sofia (Content): I'll draft the blog skeleton and the webinar agenda. Can we commit to a hero example? Maybe "build a small refapp search assistant" using snippets.

Rachael (Design): I can do 3 social cards + an in-post hero screenshot. Need the code screenshot resolution.

AJ (Growth): inbound routing: create a HubSpot form "snippets_starterpack" + UTM tags. Can we use a gated webinar sign-up that feeds to the webinar nurture sequence? Suggest adding "snippets" tag in HubSpot.

Maya (Marketing): yes. Routing: all signups go into list 'snippets_starterpack' and be assigned to DevRel queue. @Liam will own first outreach.

Liam (DevRel): can do. Also recommend a small benchmark narrative blurb: "compare token cost & p50 latency across 3 models using our batch+cache patterns" — that'll help SDRs.

Maya (Marketing): Draft social copy ideas coming today. Need final blog + repo before Thursday EOD to get legal review.

Sofia (Content): working on draft. Also want a short tutorial video (3-4 mins) showcasing snippet usage. Someone to record.

Liam (DevRel): I can record a 6-min walkthrough. Will strip to 3 mins. Example snippet for the blog: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
resp = client.generate("Summarize this repo in one paragraph")
print(resp.text)
```

Maya (Marketing): Webinar planning — proposed date Tue May 19 10am PT. Speaker list: Liam (demo), Sofia (use cases), Maya (launch + GTM). RSVP link to the HubSpot form.

Rachael (Design): for assets, I'll add 2 hero banners and 1 thumbnail. Will push to /assets/snippets-livelaunch by Wed.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview for repo is up: https://preview.redwood.ai/snippets-start-239123 — build 57.

Maya (Marketing): perfect. Checklist for launch: 1) repo + README + license, 2) blog post + screenshots, 3) webinar landing page + form, 4) social assets, 5) benchmark results and short blurb, 6) inbound routing rules, 7) legal/compliance sign-off.

AJ (Growth): I'll set UTM templates and campaign tracking today. Also propose a small paid test on X with the hero card week after launch.

Sofia (Content): Draft blog outline: intro, why snippets matter, how to use (code + demo), benchmark results, next steps (webinar + download). I'll drop PR by EOD.

Maya (Marketing): Excellent. Quick ask: everyone add final deliverable to the Launch Jira epic (LAUNCH-2981). Ping me when updated. :thumbsup: 

Liam (DevRel): Added my tasks. :rocket: 

Rachael (Design): Uploaded design assets to Figma, comment thread @Maya for color tweaks.

AJ (Growth): HubSpot form created -> form ID HS-4472. Routing rule pointing to 'devrel@redwood.com' queue.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks all. We'll do a final dry-run next Mon 5/18 11am PT. If anything blocks, flag here.
